# Express Septic Tank Pumping

> Owner-operated septic tank pumping company based in Estero, Florida, serving Lee, Collier and Charlotte County plus LaBelle (Hendry County). Residential septic pumping starts at $399.99.

## Contact
- Business: Express Septic Tank Pumping LLC
- Address: 23357 Olde Meadowbrook Circle, Estero, FL 34134
- Phone: (239) 451-3261
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Email: expressseptictankpumping@gmail.com
- Online requests: https://book.servicem8.com/request_booking?uuid=019fca12-b6bf-721c-8a2b-41d89e1a1b5b (a request; the business contacts the customer to confirm a time)
- Google reviews: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=796203008963075980

## Services and prices
- [Residential septic tank pumping](https://expresssepticpumping.com/residential-septic-tank-pumping/): from $399.99. Your final price depends on tank size, tank access, whether the lid needs locating or digging, and after-hours visits. Locating and digging up a buried lid is $100, plus $50 for each additional hour.
- [Septic tank riser installation](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-tank-riser-installation/): 6-inch risers $299.99 each. A riser brings the tank lid up to ground level so future pump-outs don't need digging.
- Buried lid locating and digging: $100, plus $50 for each additional hour
- [Commercial grease trap service](https://expresssepticpumping.com/commercial-grease-trap-service/): restaurants and commercial kitchens, one-time or recurring. Call for a quote.
- [Septic repair](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-repair/): quoted after we look at the system. Repair work performed under Florida Certified Plumbing Contractor Raymond F. Dibble, License #CFC020332.
- [Commercial septic tank pumping](https://expresssepticpumping.com/commercial-septic-tank-pumping/): call for a quote.
- [Septic inspections](https://expresssepticpumping.com/septic-inspections/): septic inspection with pump-out $549.99.

## Credentials
- Work performed under Florida Certified Plumbing Contractor Raymond F. Dibble, License #CFC020332, licensed since 1981.
- USDOT 6673233. Truck: 4,200-gallon split tank, one side for septic and one for grease.
